shows.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
shows.episodeTitle: Round of 32: Argentina vs. Cape Verde
shows.description: Argentina vs. Cape Verde in a Round of 32 match in Miami, Fla. A sea of Argentine blue and white awaits the underdog Blue Sharks of Cape Verde (three draws in group stage) as their maiden World Cup adventure finds them up against the reigning champions, playing in the backyard of Lionel Messi's current club Inter Miami. Messi's six goals share the Golden Boot lead with Kylian Mbappe.

shows.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir
shows.description: When Paris is in peril, Marinette becomes Ladybug. Little does she know, her school crush Adrien is actually Cat Noir, another city-saving superhero.

shows.title: NCIS: Hawai'i
shows.description: The world's most successful television series continues on the seductive shores of the Aloha State with NCIS: HAWAI ' I, where the first female Special Agent in Charge of NCIS Pearl Harbor, Jane Tennant, has thrived and risen through the ranks by equal parts confidence and strategy in a system that has pushed back on her every step of the way.
